title: GraphLock closure can certify incomplete mandatory product surfaces
affected_paths: EP-033, EP-034, GraphLock node verification, apps/web, apps/desktop, apps/mobile
root_cause: NODE_DONE recorded for EP-033/EP-034 while their own certification says Tauri shell, app-store/PWA deployment, Android APK, native passkeys/biometrics/Bluetooth/push/secure-enclave are NOT ASSERTED. node-artifact-check.py only establishes that milestone-declared files exist.
regression_test: scripts/rx001-graphlock-v2-tests.sh (closure semantics: zero-tests, copied-manifest, forged-evidence hostile cases)

title: Production readiness CLI uses a weaker evaluator capable of false-positive readiness
root_cause: VERIFIED_FIXED

title: Default-branch CI and release workflow are not enforcing the repository's declared ship gate
root_cause: Default branch is unprotected master; push CI triggers on main, not master. release.yml runs an EP-042 M1-era subset instead of the final canonical verification ladder.

title: Canonical build can report success without producing required production artifacts
affected_paths: scripts/build.sh, scripts/verify.sh build stage, EP-042 release artifacts
root_cause: build.sh substitutes Python bytecode compilation when uv build --package nexus-voice fails, performs a Flutter debug bundle build, declares Android APK/native build and release signing/SBOM NOT ASSERTED, yet finishes with build: ok.

title: security-check.sh proves substantially less than SECURITY.md claims
root_cause: SECURITY.md describes static analysis, OPA/policy, IaC/container checks, secrets, dependency audits, license controls, signature verification, forbidden routes and tenant-isolation tests; the script performs only env/secret-pattern, dependency audit, license and reality-gate checks.

title: GitHub Actions use mutable action tags contrary to the repo's own supply-chain policy
root_cause: CI/nightly/release use actions/checkout@v4 and jdx/mise-action@v2 despite SECURITY.md requiring immutable commit SHAs.

title: EP-004 is closed without production PostgreSQL repository / UnitOfWork / pgvector adapters
root_cause: Only repository/UnitOfWork traits exist; no concrete PostgreSQL implementations. The 'real PostgreSQL integration test' bypasses production abstractions with raw test SQL. Tenant isolation is application convention, not DB RLS; memory_embeddings tenant_id FK binds only memory_id.

title: EP-005 claims durable restart/resume while NATS checkpoint persistence is a no-op and outbox/inbox are absent
root_cause: checkpoint() always returns None; save_checkpoint() succeeds without storing; durable consumer name changes with after_sequence. No OutboxRepository/InboxRepository implementations. The restart proof polls once and manually changes sequence rather than restarting the consumer.

title: Gmail production adapter does not match the Gmail API and its send path uses a draft ID as the recipient
root_cause: Deserializes Gmail responses into a Nexus-specific shape that does not match Google's wire format (historyId/internalDate types, payload.headers vs custom from_header/to_headers/subject). Send path constructs To: from request.draft.as_str() instead of resolving the stored draft.

title: Email attachments are unimplemented across every concrete mail provider despite being an EP-026 acceptance obligation
affected_paths: Gmail, Microsoft Graph, IMAP/SMTP mail providers, ArtifactStore
root_cause: All concrete list_attachments() implementations return an empty collection; ArtifactStore materialization is deferred. A real email with attachments is represented as having none.
regression_test: fetch_attachments payload.parts / Graph attachments / BODYSTRUCTURE walk

title: Sandboxed skills execute as unrestricted host subprocesses; declared permissions are not an OS security boundary
affected_paths: SkillExecutor, ADR-025 sandboxed skills, EP-018 execution record
root_cause: SkillExecutor verifies the signed package and declared permissions, then executes with Command::new. No filesystem/namespace/seccomp isolation, privilege drop, or network enforcement. Permissions are communicated via NEXUS_SKILL_* env vars a hostile payload can ignore; live-fire fixture voluntarily obeys them.

title: Headscale MeshController synthesizes unrelated node identities and returns a nonexistent WireGuard private-key reference
root_cause: register_node() ignores the supplied WireGuard public key, generates an unrelated random mkey, creates a synthetic node; wireguard_config() fabricates openbao:mesh/{tenant}/{node_id} with no code creating/storing that key. Live proof uses placeholder keys and never resolves the private-key reference or attempts a handshake.

title: Local/NAS ArtifactStore does not enforce tenant isolation
root_cause: LocalArtifactStore ignores tenant on put/get/verify/delete/create_backup/restore/migrate/list/set_retention and does not require metadata.tenant to match the caller; NAS delegates to Local. Cross-tenant access when a store root is shared.

title: Remote encryption before egress is metadata-only
root_cause: Production writes supplied bytes unchanged; tests label plaintext as AES-256-GCM and verify the same plaintext returns. SeaweedFS records encryption_applied = metadata.encryption.is_some(). Actual AES-GCM exists only in the live-fire harness. Violates SPEC-024 client-side encryption.
regression_test: sh scripts/ep037-m2-tests.sh; sh scripts/ep037-m3-tests.sh; sh scripts/ep037-m5-tests.sh

title: EP-037 backup/restore is not a self-contained disaster-recovery mechanism
root_cause: Backup mostly creates manifests for objects already in the store; restore verifies existing objects rather than reconstructing a wiped target. LF-002 manually copies artifacts and reconstructs in-memory representations instead of restoring real databases/Keycloak/OpenFGA/pgvector/connectors.

title: Local/NAS content-addressed dedup deletion can destroy still-referenced artifacts
root_cause: Local storage deduplicates identical bytes into one content-hash object but deletes the object when any artifact reference is deleted, without other_refs_exist protection (S3/SeaweedFS have it). Tests prove two ArtifactIds can share one physical object.

title: EP-019 self-healing safety plane has no production IncidentEngine implementation
root_cause: Repository-wide search finds the trait but no production implementation. LF-019 directly constructs successful SandboxVerdict/SecurityVerdict/approval/canary objects; real operations are subprocess failure, patch, rerun, file-copy rollback. Approval-mismatch tests make the caller responsible for comparison.

title: Notification delivery policy ignores several fields it claims to enforce
root_cause: allows() evaluates only minimum urgency and channel allowlisting; quiet-hours suppression, required acknowledgement/presence, expiry and envelope channel intersection are not enforced by the router.

title: Canonical notification router cannot actually perform its proven Push-to-SMS fallback
root_cause: SmsChannelProvider::deliver() always fails because the canonical ChannelProvider call has no destination; the functional method is deliver_to(). Live-fire keeps a second SMS provider outside the router and manually calls deliver_to() after route(), labeling it router escalation.

title: Primary ICTFax production provider cannot bind an outbound fax to its destination/document
root_cause: Validates job fields then posts empty media body, creates generic program and transmission with {}; recipient/document data never reach the provider request. Inbound fetch produces size 0, empty SHA-256, no bytes. LF-030 certifies HylaFAX, not this transport.
regression_test: ICTFax real media document/program/transmission binding + real sha256

title: Telephony consent/disclosure policy is enforced only after recording and transcription
root_cause: Orchestrator starts recording, retrieves WAV and runs Whisper before evaluating consent; checked-in negative-disclosure evidence has recording_consented:false yet records successful start, 34,604 audio bytes and full transcript. TranscriptGate not used in the Asterisk runtime.
regression_test: consent evaluated BEFORE recording; zero capture negative evidence

title: Skill and coding-agent subprocess runners can deadlock indefinitely
root_cause: VERIFY-009 resolved: stdout drained synchronously to EOF before stderr, no execution timeout. A child filling stderr while keeping stdout open blocks itself while the parent waits forever. EP-017 ProcessRunner repeats the pattern.

title: Temporal does not enforce Nexus's permanent/transient retry classification
root_cause: VERIFY-008 resolved: isRetryable() correctly marks VALIDATION/POLICY/AUTH permanent, but toTemporalRetry() maps only backoff/maximumAttempts; nonRetryableErrorTypes and non-retryable ApplicationFailure are never supplied, so permanent failures get up to five attempts.
regression_test: infra/temporal/src/__tests__/ep006_official_environment_interceptor.test.ts (official env, real server binary); tests/workflows/src/ep006_failure_retry_classification_real.test.ts (real temporalio/server:1.31.2 E2E: permanent never retried, transient retried); temporal unit suite 75/75

title: X reply implementation creates an ordinary standalone post
root_cause: reply() ignores the conversation/thread reference and calls create_tweet(text); HTTP sends only {"text":...}. X's official schema has a distinct reply object; production never supplies it. LF-027 fixture accepts every POST /2/tweets.
regression_test: reply_to_tweet official reply object; thread_ref stripped of x:

title: Sentinel containment authorization is forgeable mutable state, not an approval binding
root_cause: Approved enum state is treated as authority; proposal has no approver/assertion/action digest/auth strength/immutable approval receipt. LF-009's approved_proposal() reconstructs the proposal with state: Approved and immediately mutates the firewall. No production caller forces Action Gateway.

title: Sentinel quarantine does not bind containment to the actual network identity it claims to verify
root_cause: Firewall source saved from device.label (display field) while observed IP lives in ip_ref; LF-009's quarantined device labeled 'unknown-scan-device' is accepted as firewall source_net. Verification checks rule ID/enabled/block but never reads back the source network.

title: AdGuard read_blocklist() does not read the configured blocklist
root_cause: Production derives blocklist entries from the most recent 100 query-log records with FilteredBlackList reason; the documented /control/filtering/status filter-state API is not implemented. Configured rules with no recent hit disappear; recent hits are mistaken for configuration.

title: EP-030 NetworkInventory / device fingerprint / behavior-baseline core has no production implementation
root_cause: Provider contract defines NetworkInventory; repository-wide search finds the unbound provider and test-side value construction but no real inventory implementation. Contract test manually creates devices/baselines instead of discovering/learning them.

title: Automated quarantine does not implement mandatory owner notification
root_cause: notified_owner initialized false; no production path sets it or invokes an owner-notification operation during containment. Devices can be quarantined and revoked without the required safety notification.

title: EP-031's advertised Suricata profile/fallback is not implemented
root_cause: Suricata crate contains EVE vocabulary/value types only; its own source says the adapter/live-fire arrives later. M5 exercises Zeek/CrowdSec/Wazuh/osquery, not Suricata, so an advertised deployment profile cannot operate despite node closure.

title: Sentinel bounded responses become preauthorized without high-confidence or reversibility proof
root_cause: preauthorized derived from kind.is_bounded_containment() alone; incident confidence is not used and no provider-specific reversibility proof exists. Violates the rule that only preauthorized high-confidence reversible containment may auto-execute.

title: Unrelated context events can inflate Sentinel incident confidence
root_cause: Triage establishes an indicator group then counts additional context events without requiring them to corroborate the same indicator. LF-009's HIGH narrative requires independent planes corroborating the same indicator; the generic algorithm does not enforce it.

title: Sentinel can verify one response plan using a different containment proposal
root_cause: Single registered applied proposal; verify_response(plan) checks only that the plan is bounded, not that the stored proposal binds to that plan ID/incident/target before firewall verification. Evidence from proposal B can produce VERIFIED for plan A.

title: Zeek timestamps corrupt the minute field
root_cause: Formatter derives hour/minute/second then shadows the minute variable while computing the month; final RFC3339 uses the month as both month and minute. Tests check only date/hour prefix.

title: osquery enrollment has no durable endpoint identity and supports only one effective enrolled node
root_cause: host_identifier accepted but never bound/stored; a single global node_key is replaced by the next enrollment. Telemetry lacks durable host/device binding; a second endpoint invalidates the first.

title: The production osquery TLS remote API is actually plaintext loopback HTTP
root_cause: Source advertises the documented osquery TLS remote surface, but serve() creates a raw TcpListener on 127.0.0.1 and manually exchanges ordinary HTTP; no TLS listener or TLS termination found.

title: osquery normalized evidence fabricates observation time and uses collision-prone event IDs
root_cause: Normalized rows stamped with hard-coded 2026-08-20T00:00:00Z instead of observation time; IDs derived from query ID + row index, so repeated cycles reproduce the same IDs for different observations.

title: EP-033 is closed without an actual React PWA or Tauri desktop application
root_cause: apps/web is a framework-neutral contract package; apps/desktop is a deterministic TS library with no Tauri surface; no owned browser/backend transport. The accessibility proof server-renders five shared components into fixture HTML and scans that document.
regression_test: ep033 web PWA build + a11y: real index.html/main.tsx mounts @nexus/ui, vite build emits dist

title: Desktop high-risk authorization trusts a self-declared approval-class string
root_cause: approval_class accepted from the request and merely validated against canonical strings; R3/R4 executes when the string says HUMAN/STRONG_HUMAN/FOUR_EYES with no approval assertion, ID, digest or receipt. DesktopApprovalFlow is not bound to dispatch.
regression_test: ep033 desktop+web+e2e aud039 registered profile gate hostile

title: EP-034 is closed without the required native mobile security/features
affected_paths: EP-034, apps/mobile Flutter, Android/iOS native code
root_cause: Flutter app renders 'Nexus mobile contract layer ready'; pubspec depends only on Flutter; Android is a 4-line stock FlutterActivity; no MethodChannel/native passkey, biometric, secure-storage, Bluetooth, push or background-audio implementations. M5 gate says native biometric/passkey verification NOT ASSERTED.
regression_test: ep034 native channel aud040 fail-closed hostile 10/10

title: EP-034's high-risk step-up service does not actually enforce step-up authentication or binding identity
root_cause: _guard() verifies session freshness, binding.active and two caller-supplied acting* strings; never tests session.strength, never proves session device/principal/tenant match, never proves DeviceBinding ownership. LF-022 negatives pass because an acting ID is wrong, not because single-factor is rejected; positive path constructs SessionStrength.stepUp in memory.
regression_test: flutter test ep034 approval binding: step-up denied for single/multi/none, identity+tenant binding hostile

title: EP-035 is closed without the promised Setup/secure-enrollment product
root_cause: Contract requires a nontechnical Setup flow and one-time enrollment establishing certificates/private mesh; implementation boundary remains provider-neutral state/ports plus TypeScript contracts rather than the operational setup application.
regression_test: sh scripts/ep035-m1-tests.sh; sh scripts/ep035-m2-tests.sh; sh scripts/ep035-m3-tests.sh; sh scripts/ep035-m4-tests.sh; sh scripts/ep035-m5-tests.sh

title: One-time enrollment consumption is not bound to possession of the bootstrap secret
affected_paths: EP-035 enrollment claim path, bootstrap secret
root_cause: Store persists a secret hash/nonce, but the atomic claim path takes only credential ID + time; secret verification is a separate operation, so a caller knowing an enrollment credential ID can consume it without proving the secret in the atomic transition.
regression_test: pnpm --filter @nexus/onboarding exec vitest run src/__tests__/integration; pnpm --filter @nexus/onboarding exec vitest run src/__tests__/unit; (cd tests/onboarding && pnpm exec vitest run src/__tests__)

title: Owner authorization state can be persisted without traversing the passkey/recovery ladder
root_cause: Domain transition helper enforces the intended sequence, but the persistence layer accepts a supplied owner record/state directly, permitting OWNER_AUTHORIZED to be written without proving the preceding security transitions.

title: Ambiguous mutations can become retry-safe without proof that the original mutation did not occur
root_cause: Recovery treats AMBIGUOUS + RECONCILED as safe to retry without an explicit negative mutation observation, enabling duplicate consequential effects after ambiguous provider outcomes.
regression_test: pnpm --filter @nexus/setup exec vitest run src/__tests__/ep035_unit_recovery.test.ts; pnpm --filter @nexus/onboarding exec vitest run src/__tests__/integration/recovery-flow.integration.test.ts

title: EP-036 is closed without operational cloud/SSH provisioning
affected_paths: EP-036, cloud provider crates, OpenTofu/cloud-init/SSH bootstrap
root_cause: M5 evidence explicitly leaves DigitalOcean/AWS/Contabo/Hetzner API use, OpenTofu plan/apply, cloud-init, authenticated SSH bootstrap, fleet enrollment and physical node readiness NOT ASSERTED; provider crates are predominantly bindings/validation rather than CloudProviderPort implementations.

title: Placement may select unknown/unhealthy compute using self-declared capacity
root_cause: Nodes begin with no observed capacity and unknown health; placement uses declared CPU/RAM without requiring observed capacity, API health or resource health.

title: Declared cost/trust/latency/availability placement constraints are not actually enforced
root_cause: max_estimated_cost_per_month exists but evaluate() never evaluates it; required trust/locality/availability constraints do not appear in the placement decision.

title: Local/NAS ArtifactStore ignores its tenant boundary
root_cause: Tenant is part of every ArtifactStore operation but the local implementation ignores it and resolves the shared index/object namespace by artifact ID alone; NAS delegates. Cross-tenant read/list/verify/delete when a root is shared.

title: Local/NAS deletion can destroy content still referenced by another artifact
root_cause: Content objects are globally hash-deduplicated but local deletion removes the hash object unconditionally; S3 has other_refs_exist() guard, local/NAS does not.

title: Encryption before egress can be satisfied by metadata while the bytes remain plaintext
root_cause: Local delegates encryption to its caller; NAS/S3 check encryption metadata rather than ciphertext. S3 encryption test supplies plaintext, attaches AES-256-GCM metadata and expects the identical plaintext back.
regression_test: sh scripts/ep037-m2-tests.sh; sh scripts/ep037-m3-tests.sh; sh scripts/ep037-m5-tests.sh

title: Backup manifests are unsigned despite SPEC-024 requiring signed manifests
root_cause: BackupSet contains no signature; restore authenticates only hashes/JSON structure, not a signer or signature.

title: LF-002 does not prove disaster recovery of a destroyed control-plane host
root_cause: Proof reconstructs a handful of hand-built domain records into temporary/in-memory state; it does not replace a destroyed control-plane machine and restore databases, identity, policy, workflows, audit and operational runtime.

title: EP-038 is closed without operational OTel/Prometheus/Grafana monitoring
root_cause: OTLP layer serializes data but does not export it; M5 leaves Grafana networking, Prometheus scraping, OTEL Collector, fleet telemetry, alert destinations and production monitoring NOT ASSERTED.

title: GlitchTip https:// DSNs are silently sent over plaintext HTTP/TCP
root_cause: DSN parsing accepts HTTPS, but delivery uses a raw TcpStream and manually emits HTTP with X-Sentry-Auth; the scheme never causes TLS negotiation.
regression_test: infra/glitchtip/src/transport.rs + dsn.rs (https TLS hostile + positive proofs)

title: Incident correlation/trace context is stripped before GlitchTip delivery
root_cause: Redaction reconstructs telemetry with principal/tenant/request/correlation/trace/action context absent; GlitchTip sink explicitly ignores its correlation argument, breaking SPEC-007 incident correlation.
regression_test: infra/glitchtip/src/sink.rs + incident.rs (correlation reaches wire; context rendering); infra/observability/src/runtime.rs (redact_with_context + report_incident_with_context); hostile+positive aud056 proofs

title: GlitchTip-outage quarantine is only process-local
root_cause: Fallback sink and audit log are in-memory; provider outage followed by process loss drops the quarantined incident instead of preserving it for later synchronization.

title: GlitchTip acknowledge/resolve do not mutate incident state
root_cause: Both operations validate and return success but do not remove/update the incident in the open-dedupe map; a resolved fingerprint remains open and keeps suppressing reports.

title: Supply-chain evidence has a checksum, not a cryptographic signature
root_cause: Tamper seal is SHA-256 stored beside the evidence and recomputed during verification; ArtifactSigner has no implementation. Anyone able to change evidence can change its checksum.

title: The certified SBOM path is Cargo-centric, not a complete shipped-product SBOM
root_cause: Inventory based on Cargo.lock/Rust manifests although Nexus contains pnpm/TypeScript, Flutter/Dart, images, model/data artifacts; EP-039 concedes production-artifact SBOM completeness and container provenance are not asserted.

title: GitHub Actions violate the immutable-SHA pinning rule
root_cause: SPEC-019 requires immutable action SHAs; CI/release use mutable tags including actions/checkout@v4 and jdx/mise-action@v2.

title: EP-040 never enforces its required three consecutive full verifies
root_cause: ConsecutiveVerify correctly models the rule but new(3) is used only in unit tests; the M5 gate runs the chaos suite and one set of M1-M4 regressions, never three full verifies feeding the policy.

title: EP-040's performance certification never measures runtime performance
root_cause: Deterministic budget evaluator whose own source says real load generators/hardware timing are not asserted; M5 reruns the evaluator rather than generating real latency/resource observations.

title: EP-041 closes a QLoRA/GGUF training node without executing training or quantization
root_cause: M5 requires a deliberately fixture-only GGUF marker and executes policy-level pytest proofs; no model is trained or quantized, no reproducibility or quantization comparison evidence exists.

title: EP-042 can mark a release bundle VERIFIED without verifying its component signatures
root_cause: verifyBundle() proves file hashes, manifest digest and bundle self-digest but never cryptographically checks SignedComponent.signature; M5 supplies dummy ED25519 signatures (AAAA01BBBB01) and expects verification success. No signature-verifier implementation exists.

title: Rollback can issue a VERIFIED receipt for the wrong backup
root_cause: rollbackRelease() checks only that the backup directory exists/nonempty, restores it, then copies the caller's expectedBackupDigest directly into a verified: VERIFIED receipt; verifyBackupDigest() exists but is never called.

title: The supposedly atomic update switch destroys the current install before the replacement is committed
root_cause: Installer recursively deletes installRoot and only afterward calls renameSync; a rename/mount/filesystem failure leaves the live installation deleted. Code explicitly does not auto-rollback.

title: Installer payloads are not bound to the validated release manifest
root_cause: Staged bytes validated against caller-controlled InstallComponent.declaredDigest, not the manifest digest; extra opts.components not declared by the manifest are staged; opts.releaseId not bound to manifest.release_id.

title: Transactional install requests have no durable idempotency/duplicate guard
root_cause: installRelease() unconditionally resets its journal at entry; no completed-install lookup, install-ID ownership check, or replay refusal before filesystem mutation.

title: Manual production promotion authority is reducible to any nonempty string
root_cause: Once canary says READY_TO_PROMOTE with nonempty health criterion/evidence, any nonblank approvalRef yields APPROVED_MANUAL_ONLY; tests deliberately use 'approval-42' as sufficient authority. No authenticated approver, approval record, expiry, signature, policy lookup or requester/approver separation.

title: EP-043 does not actually verify live-fire evidence before declaring the proof PASS
root_cause: collectLiveFireProofs() finds a filename beginning with LF-NNN-; evaluateLiveFireObligation() requires only owner NODE_DONE plus a nonempty path. Evidence file is never opened, parsed, freshness-bound or checked for a PASS result.

title: The canonical readiness/ship-gate evaluation silently omits all required drills
root_cause: ReadinessInputs contains restore/rollback/provider-failover/identity-recovery/Sentinel-containment/update-failure drills, but evaluateReadiness() never evaluates inputs.drills; a separate evaluateProductionReadiness() does, creating two contradictory definitions of READY.

title: Mandatory security/privacy/performance/etc. reviews become PASS solely from filename existence
root_cause: collectReviews() sees ep043-review-<domain>* and assigns status PASS without reading or authenticating the review result.

title: Final provider/hardware certification SIGNED state is text parsing, not signature verification
root_cause: A line beginning SIGNED becomes a signed certification row with the whole RESULTS.md as evidence; the top-level validator succeeds as long as the literal string RELEASE-BLOCKING-PENDING is absent.

title: Fresh-clone acceptance can be satisfied by an evidence filename
root_cause: Returns true when an ep043-freshclone* file exists; never inspects candidate commit, commands, exit status or contents, though the Boolean directly influences readiness.

title: The release tag readiness requirement is satisfied by .git/HEAD
root_cause: collectReleaseTag() reads .git/HEAD and the gate only checks the string is nonempty; a branch pointer such as ref: refs/heads/master counts as a release tag.

title: Release artifact SHA-256 is not calculated over artifact bytes
root_cause: digestBytes() first decodes arbitrary binary bytes with TextDecoder, then hashes the resulting string; invalid UTF-8 is lossy and can collapse distinct byte sequences to the same replacement characters.

title: manifest_digest does not bind the component identity, digest, signature, SBOM or artifact reference
root_cause: JSON.stringify(manifest, Object.keys(manifest).sort()) applies the replacer array recursively, discarding nested component properties not in the top-level property list from the serialized digest input; reverification repeats the broken algorithm.

title: The release-evidence digest has the same recursive serialization flaw
root_cause: Certification state, evidence refs, drill status/timestamps, review verdicts/evidence and capability-status values are nested and not cryptographically bound; tests reproduce the flawed serialization instead of challenging nested tampering.

title: EP-043 was deliberately closed and green-tagged while its own production-readiness result was NOT_READY / BLOCKED
affected_paths: EP-043 M5 gate, PRODUCTION_READINESS.md, green/EP-043 tag
root_cause: Checked-in report has missing live-fire evidence, release-blocking certifications and all nine mandatory reviews unpassed; the M5 gate explicitly requires Decision: NOT_READY and ship-gate verdict: BLOCKED, then emits ok. ExecPlan requires all acceptance obligations before NODE_DONE/green.
regression_test: scripts/ep043-m5-tests.sh (readiness-required closure gate; hostile gate checks in rx001 battery)

title: The exact manual production deploy command cannot deploy production
root_cause: EP-043 hard-codes sh scripts/deploy.sh --dry-run; deploy.sh only supports dry-run planning and every non-dry-run invocation exits 'production deployment is not authorized'. Leaves no production deployment action at all.
regression_test: rx013-remediation-tests.sh (real deploy + tamper denial); ep042_unit_approval_tampered_signature_denied (exact manual command bound + signed)

title: EP-043's verified release manifest is generated from fixture strings, not the product artifacts being shipped
root_cause: Manifest CLI reads infra/release/fixtures/components/nexus-core and nexus-model; verification rereads those same paths; files literally contain '...fixture-component-bytes-deterministic'. Built Rust binaries, containers, web assets, mobile artifacts and real models are not hashed/verified.

title: EP-044 closes without the required runtime telemetry bootstrap
root_cause: Node contract requires telemetry context initialization at startup; main.rs initializes none and the crate has no OpenTelemetry/tracing dependency. M4 'telemetry' test only checks stdout does not expose a tenant identifier.

title: The canonical Nexus control-plane runtime is a health shell, not the application composition root
affected_paths: EP-044 main.rs, server router, local-start core
root_cause: main.rs hard-codes only health and capabilities; router exposes only /healthz, /readyz, /v1/capabilities; REST/MCP/A2A/auth/query/command/workflow/event/artifact surfaces are not composed despite SPEC-003.

title: GraphLock's scheduler does not enforce GraphLock's own DONE definition
affected_paths: ledger.sh status, graph-next.sh, GRAPH.md DONE definition
root_cause: GRAPH.md requires milestones, node verify, expected-file audit, NODE_DONE and green/<node>; ledger.sh status returns DONE solely from the latest NODE_DONE event and graph-next.sh trusts it. Remote GitHub has only five green/EP-* tags while the ledger treats the chain complete.

title: Canonical backup, restore, migration, release-build and deployment commands reference executables/packages that do not exist
root_cause: Command surface invokes cargo run -p nexus-cli and -p nexus-setup-cli, but the workspace contains no such packages (actual setup package is nexus-setup); certification expects a target/release/nexusctl binary with no implementation.
regression_test: rx013-remediation-tests.sh (phantom scan + real surfaces); deploy.sh --deploy real install; release-build real manifest

title: The canonical production-readiness command does not enforce the EP-043 ship contract
root_cause: Checks ALL_DONE, runs verify, checks only for the pending-certification marker, runs two phantom-CLI drills and checks a manifest file exists; does not execute the actual readiness decision, validate nine reviews, verify six drill classes, validate evidence integrity, confirm a real release tag or require cryptographic signing.

title: The real default branch bypasses normal push CI and has no branch protection/status requirements
affected_paths: GitHub default branch master, ci.yml push trigger main
root_cause: GitHub reports default branch master, protected:false, required status checks off; CI push trigger is branches: [main]. Direct pushes to the actual default branch do not trigger push CI and branch protection does not compensate.

title: The GitHub Release workflow does not run the release system
root_cause: On v* tags it executes only preflight, the EP-042 M1 contract gate and unit tests; no M2-M5 install/update/offline/rollback, EP-043 readiness, full verify/live-fire, artifact generation, signature verification or production-readiness. Nightly does not close the gap.

title: The claimed final fresh-clone ship proof does not perform the ship-standard fresh-clone run
root_cause: Installs pnpm dependencies, runs only EP-043 M1-M4 gates, generates a knowingly NOT_READY report and creates/verifies the fixture-based manifest; never runs scripts/verify.sh, the production-readiness command, or the full live-fire registry.
